narrative.overview: The interface is the digital expression of the VAELORA icon: a cream ribbon V on deep brown, its tip catching gold, rising out of a cross-stitch band in cream, olive, terracotta and gold. Dark feature surfaces carry the decision and the recorder; warm cream carries reading; the stitch band appears where the icon band would.
keyCharacteristics: One dark feature band per screen, closed by the icon stitch band.
Gold marks the best moment; terracotta marks motion.
The stitch colours carry conditions; poor conditions read as faded thread.
A tracked classical serif wordmark beside the real app icon.
Warm cream ground with dark brown ink; no cool or neon accents.

rules.name: The Gold Moment Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the single best moment (the recommended window, the V tip). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Motion Rule
rules.body: Terracotta means movement or action: Start, Resume, recording, the live route.

rules.name: The Thread Rule
rules.body: Conditions use the stitch colours: olive comfortable, gold acceptable, faded thread poor.

rules.name: The Quiet Serif Rule
rules.body: The serif appears only in the wordmark and display lines, never in controls, labels or numbers.

dos: Do use the real app icon (cropped from the identity sheet) wherever the brand mark appears.
Do close dark feature surfaces with the stitch band, once per surface.
Do keep numbers in Archivo tabular figures and Western digits in both languages.
Do keep notices neutral with a status dot.
donts: Don't use embroidery as a background texture or on every card.
Don't introduce cool blues, lime, purple or neon accents.
Don't set controls, labels or metrics in the serif.
Don't redraw the V; use the identity artwork.
Don't add eyebrow labels or em dashes in interface copy.
